Subject: MAP & Eval Alignment — MSA / DPA / Order Form Sequencing

Hi Lina and Procurement team,

Quick note to align on the mutual action plan (MAP) and expected sequencing for MSA / DPA / Order Form. We ran through the evaluation plan with the product squad last week and want to freeze the dependencies so procurement can estimate sign-to-live time.

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm whether Aurelia requires a countersigned DPA before order form execution, or if a DPA signature after the order form is acceptable with an interim data handling attestation?
- Are there any procurement-only signatories (finance or legal) who need to approve the order form before we route to legal?
- Please review the attached MAP (20250904-Aurelia-MAP-v1.xlsx) — it maps evaluation gates to contract milestones.

Proposed sequencing (we can adjust):
1) Finalize evaluation acceptance criteria (week 0–2)
2) Submit order form for commercial terms while MSA/DPA draft is in parallel redlines (week 2)
3) Procurement approval + signature of order form contingent on DPA counter-signature or interim attestation (week 3–4)

If we can get clarity by end of day Friday, Karthik and I will produce a condensed timeline for legal and procurement owners.

Thanks,
Kim

Subject: Re: MAP & Eval Alignment — MSA / DPA / Order Form Sequencing

Kim — thanks for the writeup and the MAP. Quick answers below: 

- Aurelia prefers the DPA signed before any production data exchange. For pilot (test data only), an interim attestation is acceptable but must be signed by our data governance lead.
- Procurement will need commercial approval from our finance approver (Tanya Shah) before order form signature. Legal signs the MSA/DPA.
- We will review the MAP and provide comments by EOD Thursday.

A few risks to flag from our side:
- If the DPA redline cycle goes >2 rounds, procurement will not approve order form until the DPA is fully agreed.
- We have a mandatory AML clause for vendors processing PHI that may require additional KBA during onboarding.

I'll attach a short checklist of procurement gating items once I sync with Tanya.

Best,
Lina Ortiz
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Aurelia Health
